subject: Kestrel Health — private cluster latency + 5xx spike; SLA risk
messages:
From: Ops Team <ops@kestrelhealth.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: ceo@kestrelhealth.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 08:12:34 -0700
Subject: URGENT: private cluster p95 latency + 5xx spike affecting API — SLA at risk

Hi Dylan / Marissa,

We are seeing a sustained jump in p50/p95 latency and an increased 5xx rate across our private cluster since ~07:50 PT. Customer-facing API latency p95 has gone from ~220ms to ~1.8s and errors (5xx) have increased from <0.1% to ~3.4% over the last 30 minutes. This is causing downstream request timeouts for client apps — our SREs are tracking an SLA window that may be breached if we don't remediate quickly.

What we did: we rolled model v2.3-q (quantized) at 07:45 as part of the performance rollout. Within ~5 minutes we saw the error spike. We've attached a diagnostic bundle and KV/cache metrics.

Attachments (included): kestrel_diag_20270803.tar.gz, kv_metrics_20270803.csv, error_rate_screenshot_0803.png

Immediate asks:
- Can Redwood temporarily revert or pin to the previous model variant (v2.2) on our private deployment?
- Any config toggles you can apply that would reduce p95 (e.g., disable prefetch, reduce batch windows, force sync KV fetch)?
- Do you want to schedule a 30min maintenance window to roll back?

This is high impact — looping in our CEO (cc) and requesting an urgent response.

Thanks,
Samira Patel
Head of Infrastructure, Kestrel Health
ops@kestrelhealth.com

---
[Included log bundle: kestrel_diag_20270803.tar.gz (log bundle, 12MB)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: ops@kestrelhealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 08:29:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: private cluster p95 latency + 5xx spike affecting API — SLA at risk

Samira — thanks for the heads up and the diag bundle. We're on this.

TL;DR: We will: 1) prepare a quick rollback to v2.2 on your private cluster, 2) push a temporary config to disable KV prefetch, and 3) open a short maintenance window to apply and validate — target start in 30 minutes, pending your OK.

Details / proposed immediate mitigations:
- Rollback model: our ops can pin the instance to v2.2 (previous verified) and restart workers. Expect ~6–10 minute downtime per shard; we'll coordinate a rolling restart to minimize impact.
- Config change: disable_kv_prefetch = true (reduces background KV fetch pressure) and reduce batch_max_wait_ms from 8 -> 4 for latency-sensitive routes.
- Fallback option: if rollback isn't acceptable, enable hosted fallback routing for the most latency-sensitive endpoints for the next 1 hour.

Action items (internal):
- Marissa: confirm customer OK for a 30-minute rolling restart window and confirm preferred time now/30min.
- Jonas / Laura: flag for exec attention — per Samira cc'ing CEO. We may need a CTO-level call if SLA is at imminent risk.
- I'll open an urgent support ticket (Zendesk 824193) and attach the diag bundle.

Samira — please confirm you want us to proceed with rollback + config changes. If yes, we'll start at T+30.

Dylan
Account Lead — Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Marissa / Dylan — OK to start at 09:00 PT. Confirmed timeline: v2.3-q rolled at 07:45, first error delta observed ~07:50. Attaching a short excerpt of worker logs and the KV fetch histogram.

Notes from our SRE:
- KV hit ratio dropped to ~62% after rollout; KV fetch latency increased ~6x.
- Errors are concentrated on shard-4 and shard-7.
- We have a temporary manual mitigation: draining shard-7 reduces error spike but doesn't eliminate p95 latency.

Requested Redwood actions:
- Please proceed with pinning to v2.2 for all shards and apply disable_kv_prefetch=true for the deployment.
- If possible, throttle concurrent batch sizes on shard-4 and shard-7 while we validate.

Thanks,
Amit Rao
SRE Lead, Kestrel Health
oncall@kestrelhealth.com

Team — quick executive summary and asks:

Summary: Kestrel Health (private/on-prem) experienced a p95 latency and 5xx spike following a quantized model rollout (v2.3-q) on 2027-08-03 at ~07:45 PT. Customer requested rollback; Redwood recommended rollback + config mitigations (disable_kv_prefetch). Customer agreed and we initiated a rolling rollback/patch; customer reports partial recovery but shard-level hotspots persist (shard-4, shard-7). CEO is informed.

Immediate asks for leadership / engineering engagement:
- Jonas: please own the CTO-level call with Kestrel and their SREs. Request: 16:00 PT today for a 30-min triage (we need declaration of next-day hotfix plan if issues persist).
- Dylan / Marissa: prepare a brief for the call (1 page) with timeline, what was rolled, and telemetry (p50/p95, 5xx trend, KV hit ratio). Attach the diag bundle and the Zendesk ticket.
- Escalation: if shard hotspots remain after rollback, we should schedule Redwood on-call kernel/runtime investigation as a highest priority — request a dev hotfix window within 24 hours.

Please confirm availability for the 16:00 PT call. I'll prepare the exec note for the COO and CS leadership if we need to extend credits/contract remediation options.

Laura Bennett
